speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) with possible secondary urinary tract infection. The combination of severe abdominal pain, dysuria, post-coital pain, recent sexual activity with inconsistent condom use, and nausea is highly suggestive of an ascending STI infection. Please confirm test results for Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and CBC immediately to guide antibiotic therapy.
